reviews.name: Paolo Nel
reviews.title: Excellent software and outstanding support
reviews.text: I started using Pixumbra Studio to improve and restore some of my old photographs, and my first impressions have been very positive. I particularly like the Portrait feature, which was able to recover facial details while keeping the results natural and faithful to the original photograph. I would also like to highlight the quality of the developer support. I encountered an issue when first launching the application and sent them the log file. The developer quickly identified and reproduced the problem, and it was fixed with the Pixumbra Studio 1.0.1 update. That level of attention and responsiveness is something I really appreciate. Another important advantage for me is that the AI processing runs locally on my PC. I am still exploring everything Pixumbra Studio can do, but based on my experience so far, it is a very interesting and well-designed application backed by a developer who genuinely listens to users. Highly recommended. 5 stars.
